Action.description:
An action attached to a binding, hook, or status slot: a bare name or an
inline table (`docs/config.md`).

ChromeCfg.description:
`[chrome]`: responsive-chrome breakpoints (`docs/status-bar.md#breakpoints`).
`0` disables a threshold; a very large value pins the opposite.

compact-cols.description: Width at or below which overlays go full-bleed horizontally.

compact-rows.description: Height at or below which overlays go full-bleed vertically.

dim-unfocused.description: Paint the panes you are not typing in faint.

min-pane-cols.description:
Narrowest pane area worth tiling into; the sidebar is not reserved
below `sidebar.width + min-pane-cols`.

new-tab-after-current.description: Open a new tab right after the one in view instead of at the end.

title.description:
The outer terminal's window title while attached: `{session}` and
`{window}` are substituted; empty leaves the title alone.

ClipboardRead.description:
What a client does with an OSC 52 clipboard read from its focused pane.
Ghostty's `clipboard-read`.

oneOf.description: Answer with the client's clipboard.
Ask before answering.
Never answer (default).

ClipboardWrite.description:
What a client does with an OSC 52 clipboard write from a pane
(`defaults.clipboard-write`, ADR-0158). Ghostty's `clipboard-write`.

oneOf.description: Set the host clipboard (default, as Ghostty and tmux).
Ask before setting it.
Drop the write.

ConnectorConfigEntry.description: One relay endpoint this server dials outbound.

cert-fingerprint.description:
SHA-256 fingerprint of the relay TLS leaf certificate. Required for a
non-loopback relay; optional on loopback for local development.

token-file.description:
Path to the relay-enrollment token. The file contains one hex token and
is re-read on every dial so rotation does not require a server restart.

CwdInheritance.description:
How a newly-spawned pane chooses its working directory
(`defaults.cwd-inheritance`).

oneOf.description: The focused pane's live working directory (default, as tmux).
Always `$HOME`.
The directory the session was created in.
The last working directory used in the window.
Always `defaults.fixed-cwd` (else `$HOME`), for new sessions too.

agent-log-bytes.description:
Bytes of records an `AgentSession` retains and replays as its
bootstrap (ADR-0103); older records are evicted with a tombstone
count. Ceiling: [`MAX_AGENT_LOG_BYTES`].

approval-max-pending.description: Actions one connection may hold for approval at once (ADR-0128).

approval-max-pending-total.description: Actions the whole server may hold for approval at once (ADR-0128).

approval-ttl-secs.description:
Seconds a held `SIGNAL` action waits for a decision before its
requester is denied (ADR-0128). Read at server start.

attach-session.description:
The session a bare `phux` or `phux attach` and a new Rune window
open, created when missing. `--session` and links still win. Unset
opens the session used last.

browser-shim.description:
Give panes a stand-in `BROWSER` that prints a link and copies it to
the attached person's clipboard, for a machine with no screen. Read
at server start.

clipboard-read.description:
What the client does with an OSC 52 clipboard read from the pane it
is focused on (`docs/program-sequences.md#clipboard-osc-52`).

clipboard-write.description:
What the client does with an OSC 52 clipboard write from the pane it
is focused on (ADR-0158).

cwd-inheritance.description: How a freshly-spawned pane chooses its working directory.

event-journal-bytes.description:
Estimated encoded bytes the event journal retains, beside
[`Self::event_journal_entries`]. Ceiling: [`MAX_EVENT_JOURNAL_BYTES`].

event-journal-entries.description:
Events the server's event journal retains for cursor replay
(ADR-0123). A cursor older than the ring gets a journal gap.
Ceiling: [`MAX_EVENT_JOURNAL_ENTRIES`].

fixed-cwd.description:
The directory `cwd-inheritance = "fixed"` starts new panes and
sessions in; `~/` expands. Unset is `$HOME`.

history-bytes.description:
Bytes of scrollback per pane (ADR-0094): the bound that actually caps
a pane's resident memory, and usually the one that binds on wide
grids. Pruning is page-granular. Ceiling: [`MAX_HISTORY_BYTES`].

history-limit.description:
Lines of scrollback per pane. libghostty prunes on this or
[`Self::history_bytes`], whichever is reached first.

keep-awake.description:
Whether the server holds an idle-sleep inhibitor (`caffeinate`,
`systemd-inhibit`) so a working agent is not put to sleep.

mouse.description:
Whether the client enables outer-terminal mouse tracking on attach
(ADR-0048). `false` leaves the host's native selection untouched.

retain-on-exit.description:
Whether a Terminal spawned without `retain_secs` stays in the
inventory, exited, after its process exits (ADR-0124).

retain-on-exit-max.description:
How many exited Terminals are retained at once; one more closes the
oldest. `0` retains none.

retain-on-exit-max-secs.description: The longest any Terminal is retained after exit.

retain-on-exit-secs.description:
Seconds a retained Terminal stays after exit when the server default
applies. Capped by [`Self::retain_on_exit_max_secs`].

session-name-template.description:
Naming template for auto-created sessions. Placeholders:
`${cwd-basename}` (default) and `${random-name}`; unknown ones pass
through verbatim.

shell.description:
Shell for new panes. `None` resolves `$SHELL`, then `/bin/sh`, once at
server start; a wire `command` always wins.

shell-integration.description:
Make the default shell of new panes mark its prompts and commands
(OSC 133) without the person editing a startup file. Read at server
start.

spawn-on-attach.description:
Command to spawn when `phux` auto-creates a session on attach.
`None` uses [`Self::shell`].

term.description:
`TERM` for server-spawned panes when the spawn's own env has none.
Default `xterm-256color`: `ghostty` is opt-in because not every app
(htop) is proven to round-trip the kitty keyboard protocol.

window-size.description:
Which size wins when concurrent views of one Terminal disagree
(ADR-0027). Governs views only: an explicit `RESIZE_TERMINAL` always
applies (ADR-0062).

ExperimentalCfg.description: `[experimental]`: opt-in flags that may change without a `SemVer` bump.

predictive-echo.description:
Mosh-class predictive local echo (ADR-0090). Unset lets the transport
decide (see [`Self::predictive_echo_for`]); an explicit value wins.

Families.description: `font-family` as written: one string or a list.

ForwardCfg.description:
`[forward]` table: TCP port and ssh-agent forwarding
(`docs/forwarding.md`).

agent.description:
Broker ssh-agent requests from this server's panes to a client that
runs `phux forward --agent`. On, every pane started afterwards gets
`SSH_AUTH_SOCK` pointing at the server's broker socket, replacing
any agent the server's own environment named. Off, the server does
not advertise `FORWARD_AGENT`, refuses the commands, and leaves
`SSH_AUTH_SOCK` alone.

allow.description:
Targets a client may reach besides this machine's loopback, each a
`host:port` or `ip:port` (`[::1]:port` for IPv6) matched exactly.
The server dials these, so list only what every holder of input
rights on it may reach.

allow-append.description:
Targets a client may reach besides this machine's loopback, each a
`host:port` or `ip:port` (`[::1]:port` for IPv6) matched exactly.
The server dials these, so list only what every holder of input
rights on it may reach.

tcp.description:
Serve `phux forward`. Off, the server does not advertise
`FORWARD_TCP` and refuses the commands.

FromPrograms.description:
`[notifications] from-programs`: whether a pane's own desktop
notification sequences (OSC 9, OSC 777) reach anyone.

oneOf.description: Ignored: no escape sequence a pane prints raises a notification.
Each becomes the pane's note, as if the program ran `phux notify`.

when.description: Match clauses; first match wins per event.

IconConfigEntry.description: One `[[icons]]` entry. Every matcher it names must match.

cwd.description:
The working folder: `*` matches any run of characters, including `/`,
and a leading `~` is the home folder.

process.description: The foreground program's name, matched exactly (`cargo`, `htop`).

KeepAwake.description:
When the server keeps the machine from idle-sleeping
(`defaults.keep-awake`).

oneOf.description: Never (default).
While at least one agent's state is `working`.
For as long as the server runs.

KeybindingsCfg.description:
`[keybindings]` table: prefix key, prefix-table, global table, and key
modes.

defaults.description:
Keep the shipped bindings. `false` starts from an empty keymap: only
your own layers' bindings apply, plus the shipped `command-palette`
keys unless you bind the palette yourself.

modes.description:
Key modes (`[keybindings.modes.<name>]`): named tables whose bindings
fire without the prefix while `enter-mode` has the mode active.

prefix-table.description: Bindings that fire after the prefix.

which-key.description:
Show the which-key popup when no chord follows the prefix within
[`Self::which_key_delay_ms`].

which-key-delay-ms.description: Milliseconds after the prefix before the which-key popup shows.

LimitsCfg.description: `[limits]` table: server-enforced ceilings on shared resources.

metadata-value-bytes.description:
Largest L3 metadata value stored at one key (`docs/protocol.md#commands-events-resources`),
in bytes; a larger write is refused (ADR-0129).

LocalHostCfg.description: `[host]`: settings for this machine as other clients see it.

color.description:
Palette id overriding this machine's automatic colour; absent or
`"auto"` keeps the hash of its short host name.

MirrorConfigEntry.description:
One display or window the server keeps a `phux agent surface mirror`
running for, in its own session named by [`Self::session_name`].

interval-ms.description: Milliseconds between captures while no input arrives (default 1000).

max-width.description: Scale frames down to at most this many pixels wide.

target.description:
What to mirror, as `phux agent surface mirror` takes it: `display`,
`display:OUTPUT`, `App`, or `App:title`.

oneOf.description: Lossless PNG.
JPEG at `quality`.

ModeOptions.description:
`[keybindings.mode-options.<name>]`: how a key mode treats keys it does
not bind.

exclusive.description:
Swallow keys the mode does not bind instead of handling them as they
are outside the mode (prefix and global bindings, then the pane).

NewWindowScreen.description: `[rune] new-window-screen`: the display a new window opens on.

oneOf.description: Where the window was when it closed, on a display still connected.
The display under the pointer.
The main display.

NotificationsCfg.description:
`[notifications]`: how the TUI tells you an agent needs you or finished
(`docs/status-bar.md#notifications`). Read by the client, live on
reload.

blocked.description: Notify when an agent becomes blocked or asks for a human.

done.description: Notify when an agent that was working finishes.

from-programs.description:
What the server does with OSC 9 and OSC 777 from a pane. Read at
server start.

sound.description: Also ring the bell (`terminal`) or play the default sound (`system`).

suppress-focused.description:
Stay quiet about the pane you are looking at while the terminal
window has focus.

oneOf.description: An OSC notification to the outer terminal; survives SSH.

The desktop notifier of the machine the TUI runs on (`osascript` on
macOS, `notify-send` elsewhere).
The terminal bell only.
No notifications.

NotifyProtocol.description:
`[notifications] terminal-protocol`: the OSC dialect `terminal` mode
writes.

oneOf.description:
Pick from the environment: OSC 99 for kitty, OSC 777 for Ghostty,
`WezTerm`, and foot, OSC 9 otherwise.
`OSC 9 ; message` (iTerm2, `WezTerm`, Ghostty, Windows Terminal).
`OSC 777 ; notify ; title ; body` (Ghostty, `WezTerm`, foot).
`OSC 99` desktop notifications (kitty).

OrganizeCfg.description:
`[organize]` table: who judges where panes belong for `phux organize`
(ADR-0174). Read by the client that runs it, never by the server.

jev-key-command.description:
Argv whose trimmed stdout is the `TypeSafe` API key, run when
`TYPESAFE_API_KEY` is unset. Unset means the environment only.

jev-key-command-append.description:
Argv whose trimmed stdout is the `TypeSafe` API key, run when
`TYPESAFE_API_KEY` is unset. Unset means the environment only.

offline.description: Decide by repository matching only and send nothing off the machine.

ParamAction.description:
Parameterized action. Per-action argument validation lives in the
dispatcher, not here.

action.description: The action name. Hooks spell it `kind`; both are accepted.

enabled.description: Whether this plugin is active for consumers that execute plugins.

PolicyCfg.description:
`[policy]`: the server's authorization posture
(`docs/remote.md#who-can-connect`, ADR-0116). Read once at start.

mode.description:
Unset is `local`, and a configured remote entry point or workload
authority location then refuses to start (ADR-0179).

tailnet-owner.description:
Under `paired`, admit this machine's owner's own tailnet devices over
the tailnet QUIC listener with no token or certificate, on the local
Tailscale client's word (`docs/config.md#tailnet-owner-devices`).

oneOf.description: Owner's Unix socket only; a configured remote listener refuses start.
Every TLS connection must present an enrolled workload certificate.

ProducerConfigEntry.description:
One command the server keeps running in its own session, named by
[`Self::session_name`]. The command runs in that session's pane, so it
opens its documents under the pane it finds in `PHUX_TERMINAL_ID`.

command.description: The argv to run. A first word `phux` is the server's own binary.

command-append.description: The argv to run. A first word `phux` is the server's own binary.

name.description: The producer's name; its session is `producer-` and the name.

The label `phux project open NAME` resolves: ASCII letters, digits,
`-`, or `_`, unique across the catalog.

recipe.description:
A recipe outside the repository (absolute or `~/`-relative), used
instead of the checkout's `.phux/project.toml`. Trusted because the
user wrote it into their own config.

QuickTerminalEdge.description: `[rune] quick-terminal-edge`: where the quick terminal opens.

oneOf.description: Across the top of the display.
Across the bottom of the display.

RemoteConfigEntry.description: A remote phux server declared in `config.toml`.

cert-fingerprint.description:
SHA-256 pin of the remote's TLS leaf certificate (required for a
non-loopback dial, ADR-0031).

client-cert.description:
The workload client certificate chain (PEM, leaf first) this client
presents to the remote over TLS, as `phux host add` enrolled it
(ADR-0116). Set together with [`Self::client_key`].

client-key.description:
The private key for [`Self::client_cert`]: an owner-only file whose
path is recorded here and whose bytes never are.

color.description:
Palette id overriding the host's automatic colour
([`crate::host_color`]); absent or `"auto"` keeps the hash of `name`.

direct.description:
A paired `quic://` endpoint kept beside an `ssh://` or `wss://` one,
tried first and promoted to `endpoint` once it answers.

endpoint.description:
Transport endpoint URI: `quic://HOST:PORT`, `wss://HOST:PORT`, or
`ssh://HOST` for the stdio bridge.

name.description: Local label `phux attach <name>` resolves (not a routable identity).

paused.description:
Paused by `phux host disable`: kept in the registry, but nothing
dials it until `phux host enable`.

remote-phux.description:
The `phux` the host runs over ssh when it is not on a non-interactive
shell's `PATH` (`--remote-phux`, or where `--install` put it), as one
word of the remote command line; absent, `phux`.

session.description: Session to attach on arrival; absent lets the server decide.

ssh.description:
The ssh destination the entry was enrolled through, used to restart a
server that does not answer; absent, the name is used.

tls-server-name.description:
TLS server name (SNI) a `quic://` or `wss://` dial offers instead of
the endpoint's host. Set, it names a relay route: the endpoint is
the relay, the pin is the relay's, and the relay splices the dial
onto the server enrolled under this route (ADR-0052, ADR-0149).

token-file.description:
Path to the pairing token file `phux pair` minted; the token itself
never appears in `config.toml`.

RestoreCfg.description: `[restore]` table: bringing panes back after a reboot or a crash.

on-start.description:
Run `phux restore` when the server starts: relaunch every pane a
server stop ended, and resume agents whose integration supports it.
Nothing is typed into a relaunched program.

program.description:
`[[restore.program]]`: the command a relaunch runs for a pane whose
program handed over a resume token (OSC 7501 `resume=`), by `app`.
A program with no entry here is never resumed.

program-append.description:
`[[restore.program]]`: the command a relaunch runs for a pane whose
program handed over a resume token (OSC 7501 `resume=`), by `app`.
A program with no entry here is never resumed.

command.description:
The argv to run, without a shell. Each element that is exactly
[`RESUME_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER`] becomes the token.

command-append.description:
The argv to run, without a shell. Each element that is exactly
[`RESUME_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER`] becomes the token.

RuneCfg.description:
`[rune]` table: settings the Rune app otherwise keeps in its own prefs.

A key set here wins over the app's saved choice and cannot be changed
from Settings; an unset key stays the app's to remember.

chief.description:
The phux session whose ACP agent a tap of the right Command key
prompts; `"chief"` when unset, `"none"` turns the tap off.

confirm-close.description: Ask before closing a terminal or tab with something running.

copy-on-select.description: Copy a selection to the clipboard as soon as it is made.

font-family.description:
Terminal font family, or families tried in order before the built-in
faces: a list, or one string with commas between names. `""` is the
built-in face.

font-size.description: Terminal text size in points each window starts at.

interface-size.description:
Size of the sidebar, tabs, palette and Settings in percent, 80 to
200; the terminal's text keeps `font-size`. 100 when unset.

key-defaults.description:
`false` drops the built-in chords: only `[rune.keys]` acts, plus the
palette and Settings chords until you bind those commands.

keys.description:
`[rune.keys]`: a chord such as `"cmd+shift+d"` and the command it
runs, or `"none"` to take a built-in chord away.

markdown-viewer.description:
Markdown renderer argv: UTF-8 Markdown on stdin, plain UTF-8 on stdout.
`{width}` expands to columns. Unset uses bundled tmd; `[]` shows source.

markdown-viewer-append.description:
Markdown renderer argv: UTF-8 Markdown on stdin, plain UTF-8 on stdout.
`{width}` expands to columns. Unset uses bundled tmd; `[]` shows source.

new-window-screen.description:
The display a new window opens on: `"current"` (where the window was
when it closed), `"mouse"` (the one under the pointer) or `"main"`.

notifications.description: Post desktop notifications for agents that need attention.

option-as-meta.description: Option sends Meta (Esc-prefixed) instead of composing characters.

quick-terminal.description:
Global chord that shows and hides the quick terminal, such as
`"ctrl+backquote"`; unset or `"none"` leaves it off.

quick-terminal-edge.description: The display edge the quick terminal drops from: `"top"` or `"bottom"`.

quick-terminal-size.description:
The quick terminal's height as a fraction of the display's, 0.2 to
0.9; 0.4 when unset.

recent-first.description: List the session used last first, instead of in the arranged order.

ssh-agent.description:
Socket of the SSH agent `ssh://` hosts use, such as
`"~/.1password/agent.sock"`: an app opened from the Dock does not
see the shell's `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`.

tab-bar.description:
Where the terminal tabs go: `"top"` in the title bar, `"bottom"` under
the panes, or `"hidden"`.

theme.description: Theme id, as the theme picker lists them; `""` follows the system.

title-bar.description:
The title bar: `"shown"`, `"hover"` (hidden until the pointer reaches
the window's top edge) or `"hidden"`.

wheel-arrows.description:
The wheel over a full-screen program that doesn't use the mouse sends
arrow keys, unless the program resets DEC 1007. On when unset.

cert-fingerprint.description: SHA-256 pin of the satellite's TLS leaf certificate.

client-cert.description:
Enrolled client certificate PEM the hub presents when the satellite
runs in `paired` mode (ADR-0116). Set together with
[`Self::client_key`]; the same pair `[[remote]]` records.

client-key.description:
The private key for [`Self::client_cert`]: an owner-only file whose
path is recorded here and whose bytes never are.

color.description:
Palette id overriding the satellite's automatic colour
([`crate::host_color`]); absent or `"auto"` keeps the hash of `name`.

enabled.description: Whether this satellite is active for hub routing.

endpoint.description: Transport endpoint URI for the satellite server.

token-file.description:
Path to the pairing token file `phux pair` minted (ADR-0038); the
token itself never appears in `config.toml`.

color.description: Palette id the session is drawn in; anything else fails the load.

name.description: The session's name, matched exactly. The first entry for a name wins.

agents-share.description:
Share of the sidebar body the Agents panel keeps, as a percent
(default `50`, half). `0` drops the panel entirely.

ADR-0112: the Agents panel on top and the Sessions panel below share
the body at a **fixed** line, whatever the agent population, so
gaining or resolving an agent never moves Sessions. An empty Agents
panel keeps its header and a quiet placeholder. Plugin sections claim
their fixed bands first, and the whole sidebar yields below
`width + chrome.min-pane-cols` columns.

hosts.description:
Segment the Sessions area by machine (ADR-0140). Default `true`.

The attached server's sessions are always shown live. The other
machines (this one, when attached to a remote, and every `[[remote]]`
host) come from a *hosts provider*: a command that prints the
`phux.hosts/v1` document, re-run every `hosts-refresh-secs`. `false`
lists only the attached server's sessions and runs no provider.

hosts-provider.description:
Hosts provider argv. Empty (the default) runs this binary's own
`ls --all --json`; any command printing the same shape replaces it,
which is the same seam a plugin uses.

hosts-provider-append.description:
Hosts provider argv. Empty (the default) runs this binary's own
`ls --all --json`; any command printing the same shape replaces it,
which is the same seam a plugin uses.

hosts-refresh-secs.description: Seconds between hosts provider runs. Default `10`; at least 2.

position.description: Which edge the sidebar docks to.

rail.description:
Keep a three-column rail while the sidebar is hidden or does not fit
(default `true`): an agents-need-you count, one state dot per session
(the active one marked), and an expand chevron. `false` hides the
sidebar completely.

recent-first.description:
List sessions most recently used first instead of in the arranged
order.

width.description:
Width in columns (default `20`). `0` sizes automatically to a quarter
of the viewport, bounded to 28-40 columns.

SidebarPosition.description: Which edge the sidebar docks to.

oneOf.description: Left (default).
Right.

StatusCfg.description: `[status]` table: three widget slots plus the row the bar reserves.

position.description: Which outer-terminal row the bar reserves.

StatusPosition.description: Which row the status bar occupies.

oneOf.description: The bottom row.
The top row (default).

TabBar.description: `[rune] tab-bar`: where the terminal tabs go.

oneOf.description: In the title bar.
Under the panes.
Nowhere; the palette and shortcuts still switch tabs.

ThemeCfg.description: `[theme]`: free-form `slot -> color` map; the renderer interprets it.

TitleBar.description: `[rune] title-bar`: whether the band over the panes shows.

oneOf.description: Always.
While the pointer is at the window's top edge.
Never; a thin strip along the top still moves the window.

UplinkConfigEntry.description:
A hub this server dials out to and serves as a satellite, written by
`phux host join`.

ca-fingerprint.description:
`sha256:` fingerprint of the hub's workload CA: the only trust the
uplink extends to the hub's certificate.

client-cert.description: The enrolled satellite certificate chain (PEM, leaf then CA).

client-key.description: Its private key: an owner-only file, never inline.

enabled.description: Whether the server keeps this uplink up.

mail-only.description:
Joined for mail and claims only (`phux host join --mail-only`): the
server never dials this hub, so the hub reaches no terminal here.

name.description:
The satellite name the hub enrolled this server as: its
`ResourceId::Satellite.host` on the hub.

server-name.description: The TLS server name offered to the hub, when it is not `hub`'s host.

VoiceCfg.description:
`[voice]`: the server-side transcriber behind `TRANSCRIBE`. The server
runs the configured command rather than embedding a model.

timeout-secs.description: Seconds before the transcriber is killed. Unset means 30.

transcriber.description:
Transcriber argv. `{path}` is replaced by the clip's path (appended
when absent); trimmed stdout is the transcript.

transcriber-append.description:
Transcriber argv. `{path}` is replaced by the clip's path (appended
when absent); trimmed stdout is the transcript.

Widget.description:
A status-bar widget: a bare kind (`"session"`) or an inline table with
`kind` plus options (`docs/status-bar.md#widget-kinds`).

WidgetSpec.description:
Long-form widget spec; options are validated per kind by
[`crate::widget::validate`].

WindowSize.description:
Which geometry wins when concurrent views of one Terminal disagree on
size (`defaults.window-size`, ADR-0027). Mirrors tmux's `window-size`.

oneOf.description: The smallest view's size; larger views letterbox (default).
The largest view's size; smaller views clamp.
The most recently resized view's size.

The size of the view last used: the one that most recently typed,
clicked, pasted, gained focus, attached or resized. Lets a phone and
a desktop share a pane without the idle one shrinking it.
A fixed size set only by an explicit `RESIZE_TERMINAL` (ADR-0062).

connector.description: Outbound relay links this server supervises (ADR-0052).

connector-append.description: Outbound relay links this server supervises (ADR-0052).

defaults.description: Server-wide defaults: shell, `TERM`, scrollback, spawn policy.

experimental.description: Opt-in unstable features; may change without notice.

extends.description: Config layers merged under this file, in order: a path, or a name for `layers/<name>.toml` beside it.

forward.description: `[forward]`: what `phux forward` may reach from this server.

hooks.description: Event hooks (`[[hooks.<event>]]`), keyed by event name.

host.description: `[host]`: this machine as clients draw it (its colour override).

icons.description: `[[icons]]`: the icon clients draw before a pane's label.

icons-append.description: `[[icons]]`: the icon clients draw before a pane's label.

limits.description: `[limits]`: server-enforced ceilings that are not per-pane defaults.

mirrors.description: Displays and windows the server keeps mirrored (`[[mirrors]]`).

mirrors-append.description: Displays and windows the server keeps mirrored (`[[mirrors]]`).

plugins.description: Declarative plugin manifests composed into this config.

plugins-append.description: Declarative plugin manifests composed into this config.

producers.description:
Commands the server keeps running as document producers
(`[[producers]]`).

producers-append.description:
Commands the server keeps running as document producers
(`[[producers]]`).

projects.description: Named projects `phux project open NAME` resolves (ADR-0152).

remote.description:

`phux host add`.

restore.description:
`[restore]`: whether a starting server relaunches what the last one
ended.

rune.description: `[rune]`: settings the Rune desktop app reads; ignored elsewhere.

Hubs this server dials out to as a satellite (ADR-0182), written by
